k:共.mnemonic: Three (三) fish are skewered on one stick (｜), their tail fins (ハ) dangling underneath. On the same skewer they roast side by side. Together (both, neither, all).

k:至.mnemonic: An arrow that has flown down and stuck point-first in the ground at the bottom. Its flight has reached its end, the final peak moment. Climax (arrive, proceed, reach).
k:至.hint: An arrow landing in the ground.

k:音.mnemonic: A little figure standing on top of a round drum, stamping on its skin: boom, boom, boom. Sound (noise, tone).

k:屋.mnemonic: The climax (至) of a long walk is spotting a flag (尸) flapping over a doorway: you have arrived, and the goods are inside. Shop (roof, house, dealer).

k:意.mnemonic: A sound (音) rising from the heart (心): the quiet voice you hear inside before you have said a word. Idea (mind, meaning, intention).

k:欠.mnemonic: A person bent forward with the mouth gaping in a huge yawn: a big empty gap where the energy should be. Lack (gap, fail, interval).

k:次.mnemonic: Icicles (冫) drip one drop at a time. Each drop that falls leaves a lack (欠), a gap, and you watch for the one that follows. Next (order, sequence, following).

k:完.mnemonic: A house built up from its origin (元), the foundation, until the roof (宀) goes on top. Nothing is missing and nothing is left to do. Perfect (completion, end, finish).

k:院.mnemonic: On a mound (阝) stands a perfect (完) building, walled and finished, looking down over the town: the hospital or temple on the hill. Institution (hospital, temple, mansion).
k:院.hint: The grand building on the hill.

k:軍.mnemonic: A car (車) with an armoured plate over its forehead (冖): a covered war chariot, and behind it roll a thousand more. Army (military, force, troops).

k:運.mnemonic: An army (軍) moving down the path (辶), hauling all its supplies behind it. Whether the load arrives is a matter of luck. Carry (luck, fortune, transport).
k:運.hint: Troops hauling supplies down the road.

k:考.mnemonic: An elder (耂) slowly rocking a cradle (勹), gazing into it and wondering what this baby will grow up to be. Consider (think about, think over).
k:考.hint: An old one pondering a cradle.

k:且.mnemonic: An eye (目) resting on one (一) wide tray. You spot one thing on it, then another slides in underneath: and another thing, and another! Moreover (also, furthermore).
k:且.hint: One more thing on the tray.

k:組.mnemonic: A thread (糸), and moreover (且) another thread, and another, all braided into a single cord, the way people are bound into a team. Group (team, assemble, association).

k:駅.mnemonic: A horse (馬) tied up under a flag (尸): the post where riders once changed horses, and where the trains stop now. Station.

k:古.mnemonic: Ten (十) standing on a mouth (口): a tale passed down through ten generations of mouths, one after another, has been around a very long time. Old.
k:古.hint: A tale told by ten generations.

k:活.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of cold water splashes an old (古) dog. Its tongue (舌) flops out and it leaps about like a puppy again. Lively (living, active, resuscitation).

k:私.mnemonic: Grain (禾) that I wrap up in my own cocoon (厶) and keep to myself: this share is private, it is mine. I (private, me).
k:私.hint: My own wrapped-up share of grain.

k:太.mnemonic: A big (大) person with a drop (丶) of belly hanging down between the legs: bigger than big. Fat (thick, plump, big around).
k:太.hint: Big, with a belly hanging down.

k:有.mnemonic: A hand, drawn as one (一) line and a slide (ノ), grips the month (月), the moon itself, from above. What you hold in your hand is yours. Have (possess, exist, happen).

k:付.mnemonic: The leader (亻) takes each recruit's measurement (寸) and pins a size tag firmly onto the collar. Attach (adhere, refer to, append).

k:面.mnemonic: A head seen from the front: the hairline on top, a box for the outline, and inside it an eye and nose framed like a mask. Face (surface, mask, aspect).
k:面.hint: A mask seen from the front.

k:青.mnemonic: A young plant sprouting above a moon: fresh shoots in cool moonlight, the colour that sits between sky and leaf. Blue (green).

k:情.mnemonic: A heartbeat (忄) that turns blue (青): when the heart goes blue with sadness or longing, you feel it thump in your chest. Emotion (feelings, passion, sympathy).

k:甘.mnemonic: An open mouth seen from the front with one line inside it: something held on the tongue to be savoured, not swallowed. Sweet (coax, pamper, be content).

k:期.mnemonic: A jar of sweet (甘) honey has to last exactly one month (月): one spoonful a day until the time is up. Period (term, time, date).
